scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w apps/api && npm run test:coverage -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared --if-present && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
